content: version in plugin.json is a plain semver string (not a range) that pins the plugin -- users only get updates when the string is bumped. If omitted, version resolves in order: marketplace entry version -> git commit SHA (git sources) -> SHA-256 digest (archive sources) -> unknown. Never set version in both plugin.json and marketplace.json entry -- plugin.json silently wins with no warning. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces (fetched directly).
